_what: What the money guard on public.organizations ACTUALLY DOES, measured by running it - not by reading its source.
_why_this_replaced_parsing_the_sql: Three versions of this check parsed the migration text with regexes, and all three reported green while every money column was unlocked. A comment in front of a clause, a nested IF, the words RAISE EXCEPTION inside a string, a later migration that merely QUOTED the function, a DISABLE TRIGGER - each one fooled a parser, and each fix grew a new hole. Text cannot answer 'is this column protected'. Running the guard can: the database is the only thing that cannot lie about its own behaviour, and a disabled trigger refuses nothing, which a probe sees and a parser never will.
_how_it_was_measured: For every column on organizations, twice: (A) as a plain org ADMIN of a QA fixture org, try to change it - 42501 means the guard REFUSED it; (B) as service_role, which the guard exempts, change it and see whether a row appears in organization_money_audit. B must be separate, because a refused write never reaches the audit trigger, so an operator probe can say nothing about whether a locked column is recorded. Every change is undone immediately and the fixture is diffed against a backup afterwards.
_regenerate_with: scripts/probe-money-guard.sql - run it against STAGING via the Supabase MCP, paste the result here, and re-run the parity query at the bottom of that file against BOTH databases.
_regenerate_when: Any migration that touches guard_organizations_locked_columns, audit_organization_money, or a trigger on organizations. The test fails and tells you to, so this is a tripwire rather than a thing to remember.
fixture_org: b177a0ea-32c6-45c9-82ac-cbb7261c2dee (Cascade Enrichment Co., a QA fixture - never a real tenant)
_parity: PROD IS EQUIVALENT, checked the same day: guard, audit, the column list and the enabled-trigger count are byte-identical on both databases, so behaviour measured on staging holds on prod. NOT identical, and NOT covered by this file: the CHECK constraints differ (prod 6526257e..., staging 43fa76b0...). That is pre-existing drift on organizations, unrelated to the guard, and is recorded here so nobody reads this file as claiming full schema parity.
_refused: The guard REFUSED an org admin's change (42501). These are platform-admin-only.
_audited: A change to these WROTE a row to organization_money_audit.
_unprobeable: Columns the probe could not test (no legal alternative value). MUST stay empty for any money column - the test fails if one appears, because an untested column is not a protected column.
